title: Whistle: Speech to Text in 16.9 MB
summary: Whistle is a speech-to-text model from Cactus Compute that runs in just 16.9 MB, making it exceptionally lightweight for on-device or edge deployment. The Hacker News discussion (826 points, 167 comments) highlights interest in compact ASR models that balance accuracy with minimal memory footprint, potentially enabling offline transcription on mobile and embedded devices.
